action_regret.definition: Expected-survivor regret is the selected legal guess's expected remaining-candidate count minus the minimum expected count among all allowed words for the same candidate set; it is a heuristic diagnostic, not the GRPO reward.

candidate_reduction.definition: Candidate sets start from the full words universe and are filtered using the validation secret's true feedback after each legal guess.

reward_definition: For each legal action, reward = ln(candidate_count_before / candidate_count_after) + solve_bonus if the guess solves the game. Illegal actions receive no feedback, candidate reduction, or reward.
